headline: The vendored framework moves to blamejs 0.21.9, and an HTTP/2 stream that closes early fails at once
summary: The vendored framework moves from blamejs 0.21.8 to 0.21.9. An HTTP/2 request whose stream closes before the response headers arrive now fails at once instead of waiting for the request timeout, and an HTTP/2 download cut off when its connection closes is retried. To upgrade, install the new binary or pull the new image. The configuration file and the state database carry over unchanged.

items.title: An HTTP/2 stream that closes early fails without waiting for the timeout
items.body: When the server closes an HTTP/2 stream before it sends response headers, the request now fails with `http-client/h2-stream-error` and the reset code, when there is one. Before this release the request waited until its timeout expired.

items.title: An HTTP/2 body cut off by a closed connection is retried
items.body: A response body whose HTTP/2 connection closes before the stream ends now fails with the transient `http-client/truncated-body`, and the client retries it. Before this release such a body could be read as complete.

items.title: Vendored blamejs 0.21.9
items.body: `vendor/blamejs/` is `@blamejs/core` 0.21.9, checked against the integrity hash the npm registry publishes. It carries `@blamejs/pki` 0.9.13 and the 2026-11-20 Public Suffix List. blamejs 0.21.9 requires Node.js 26.13.1, which this client already requires.
